description: "The Cruise of the Frolic" by W.H.G. Kingston is a fictional narrative written in the mid-19th century. This seafaring adventure captures the experiences of a group of young people as they embark on nautical journeys aboard the yacht "Frolic," led by the exuberant Ned Hearty.
